About us

Better for you. Better for the planet.

Pure hydration in paper-based packaging. Zero plastic waste, zero compromise.

Why we started

Water shouldn't cost us our health or the planet.

Plastic pollution and microplastics are harming both. So we rethought how water is packaged.

100% microplastic free

Made to come full circle

Sip. Open. Recycle. Return.

Our pillars

Small choices, real change.

Health first

No microplastics. No synthetic chemical transfer.

Responsible footprint

Fossil-fuel plastic replaced by renewable paper.

Our purpose

Ending single-use plastic, one carton at a time.

Join the wave

Every carton you choose makes a difference.

Switch from plastic and become part of the solution.

Shop sustainable water Partner with us

Sustainability

Small sips, big change.

If we take from the planet, we should give back. Every carton is built on that idea.

Our commitment

1% of revenue, back to the planet.

We're proud to partner with 1% for the Planet, the global movement of purpose-driven brands that includes Patagonia and 818 Tequila.

At least 1% of our annual revenue goes to environmental organizations fighting plastic pollution, protecting oceans and restoring ecosystems.

Water brand. Water guardian.

Thoughtful packaging

Every detail, a little kinder.

FSC® certified cartons

Paperboard from responsibly managed forests that protect biodiversity and prevent deforestation.

Paper tape

Shipping boxes are sealed with paper, not plastic tape, so they're easier to recycle.

Seed paper inserts

Plant them and they grow. Instead of waste, a little something given back.

After your last sip

Recycled, then reborn.

  1. 1

    Collected

    Our recycling partners process beverage cartons and keep them out of landfill.

  2. 2

    Separated

    The layers in each carton are split and recovered for reuse.

  3. 3

    Reborn

    They become durable composites for coasters, tables, chairs and more.
